episodeTitle.en: Why most public speaking advice is wrong—and how to finally overcome anxiety | Tristan de Montebello
episodeTitle.zh: 为何大多数公众演讲建议都是错误的——以及如何最终克服焦虑 | 特里斯坦·德·蒙特贝洛

guestBioOfficial.en: Tristan de Montebello is the co-creator of Ultraspeaking, the most effective method I’ve come across for rapidly improving communication and presentation skills. In 2017, Tristan became the fastest person ever to reach the finals of the World Championship of Public Speaking, achieving this feat in just seven months with no prior experience. In our conversation, we discuss: • Why public speaking is a meta skill that can transform your life
guestBioOfficial.zh: 特里斯坦·德·蒙特贝洛是Ultraspeaking的联合创始人，这是我所知晓的提升沟通和演讲技巧最有效的方法。2017年，特里斯坦仅用七个月时间便毫无经验地闯入世界公共演讲锦标赛决赛，成为史上最快达成这一壮举的人。对话中，我们将探讨：• 公众演讲为何是能改变人生的元技能

title.en: Why most public speaking advice is wrong—and how to finally overcome anxiety | Tristan de Montebello
title.zh: 为何大多数公众演讲建议都是错误的——以及如何最终克服焦虑 | 特里斯坦·德·蒙特贝洛

summary.en: Tristan shares how to become a dramatically better, more comfortable speaker, including speaking on the spot without panic. He explains the mindset and reps that build speaking confidence, why most fear is learned, and how communication accelerates your career. The episode is a practical, energizing guide to a skill that pays compounding dividends.
summary.zh: Tristan 分享了如何成为显著更优秀、更从容的演讲者，包括在毫无准备下临场发言而不慌乱。他解释了构建演讲信心的思维与练习、为何大多数恐惧是习得的，以及沟通如何加速你的职业生涯。本期是一份务实、令人振奋的指南，关乎一项带来复利回报的技能。
